preferred_rationale: Only figure given for the initial phase; consistently reported across outlets, but appears in no planning or grid document located.
notes: Described as 'an initial 600 megawatts of both renewable and grid connected power'. No planning application or grid connection evidence for 600 MW was located.
'Multi-gigawatt' campus ambition — no specific figure. Recorded with minimum 1,000 MW purely as the literal floor of 'multi-gigawatt'; aspirational and unsupported by any application or grid record.

Claim of 'access to three gigawatts of renewably generated wind energy' — refers to potential offshore wind (ScotWind/INTOG, Cerulean Winds Aspen) that might be linked by private wire, not on-site generation or a contracted supply. Recorded as a claim of available renewable supply, not capacity of the facility.
